eventDetail.scope: 2026 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Next-Generation Technologies (ICONET) is a scientific venue dedicated to sharing advances in computing, intelligent systems, and next-generation communication technologies. It brings together researchers, academics, and industry professionals to present original research, exchange knowledge, and explore emerging trends in areas such as AI, network architectures, cybersecurity, and cloud and edge systems. ICONET26 will feature advanced research presentations by invited keynote speakers in Computer Engineering. This conference is the official scientific event for the IEEE Computer Society Lebanon Chapter and will be hosted in 2026 by the Faculty of Engineering at Beirut Arab University, Lebanon.
